data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nazaha', which means 'to guide' or 'to help'. In Islamic tradition, Nazeeya is a name given to a girl who is believed to be a guide or helper for others. The name Nazeeya carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazeeya usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
